scope: One hundred complete October 2022 native card bodies reviewed:97 definitions updated and3 retained. Restore mana accounting and native producers, attack/spell/leave-play/ETB dispatch, packed per-player damage, extra-combat effects, protection, attachment death triggers, mass-action ordering, native payment/sacrifice helpers and token constants. Original source names, helper APIs, macros and linkage retained without analysis-name aliases. Aligned assembly confirms single damage dispatch per player for Balefire Dragon, packed damage for Needle Specter, extra-combat state fields and the existing engine legal-attacker wrapper. Native bytes, DWARF contracts, literal data, 150 source/native enum values, 149 callee/callback identities/prototypes and seven complete source dependencies pinned. Independent callee bodies and gameplay remain separately tracked; no generated-byte or whole-program equivalence claim.
